test_graph_equality: test gtn.equal to check if two graphs have identical nodes, arcs, labels, and weights
test_graph_isomorphism: test gtn.isomorphic to check if two graphs have the same structure regardless of node ordering
test_loadtxt_graph: test gtn.loadtxt to load a graph from a text file and verify it matches the original
test_savetxt_graph: test gtn.savetxt to save a graph to a text file and verify the output format
test_save_load_graph: test gtn.save and gtn.load to serialize and deserialize a graph to/from a binary file
